_note: The set of database RPCs and edge functions this app depends on. Auto-verified by __tests__/backendContract.test.ts on every CI run: if the app adds/removes a backend dependency, that test fails and this file must be updated CONSCIOUSLY. When you update it, make sure any NEW entry actually EXISTS and is DEPLOYED on the live DB (run: node scripts/check-backend-live.mjs). This is the guard against the repo<->production drift found on 2026-06-26. Reconciled with live on 2026-06-26.

rpcs.name: get_priority_reports
rpcs.signature: get_priority_reports(p_limit integer, p_cursor_count bigint, p_cursor_created timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid)
rpcs.why: #24 — this existed under a name the app knew and a signature it could not call, so a name-only check reported it healthy while every call 404'd and the Tribunal showed an empty docket. Signature-checked from here on.

rpcs.name: get_taste_profile
rpcs.why: New in the taste pass. Signed rather than named because #24's lesson was 'signature-checked from here on', and a new function is the cheapest possible moment to pin one — it replaces the TMDB fetch that capped a member's fingerprint at 60 films, so a silent 404 here would not break the screen, it would quietly show a WRONG portrait.

_removedNote: TWO entries left this contract on 2026-09-03, and NEITHER is a signal to undeploy anything. This file describes what the CURRENT mobile source calls; it is not an inventory of what production must keep. (1) fetch-rss — the Global Wire left the Dispatch and NewsService with it. (2) get_dispatch_feed — the Dispatch store now reads dispatch_posts directly. That RPC MUST STAY DEPLOYED: the build in members' hands on TestFlight calls it, and so does the web app, which is a separate tree on the same project. Step one's compatibility layer exists precisely so those keep working.
_securityNote: Facts about the LIVE database that no test can derive from this repo. Added 2026-08-10 after the schema snapshot misled three times in two days: it showed a column-unrestricted profiles UPDATE policy (live is locked to 7 columns), it showed two conflicting role whitelists (live has one, permitting 'admin' — acting on the snapshot would have locked out the moderators), and it showed email as world-readable (live denies it). Each entry below was OBSERVED live, not read from a migration. If one of these ever flips, this fails loudly instead of a person discovering it during an audit.

anonMustNotRead.why: F-15 — world-readable email is mass harvesting
moderation detail; not the member's business
decides who may demote a tier; must not be visible or writable

anonMustRead.why: CONTROL. If the API is down or the key is wrong every probe above 'passes' by failing. This one must return 200 or the whole anon check is meaningless.

mustBeEnabledTriggers.why: pins role, tier, ban state, trust_score and entitlement_source on UPDATE. A DISABLED trigger looks identical to a working one everywhere except tgenabled.
stops a banned member editing their way out of recognition
keeps the copied handles honest — the impersonation fix
